title: Chapter 112: The Underground War (Part 2)
content:
Chapter 112: The Underground War (Part 2)

Wu Qing and the Zerg guards personally cleared the way and led the first batch of Zerg troops into the ghouls, stopping the corrosive mucus attacks of the giant ghouls that did not distinguish between friend and foe.

During the charge, many Zergs were attacked by the corrosive mucus. Even with the super corrosion resistance of the Zerg carapace, they were corroded into pits and pits, resulting in reduced defense capabilities.

If ordinary creatures were sprayed on, they would probably be corroded into a pool of liquid in an instant!

Fortunately, this terrifying race has not been born, otherwise all the surrounding territories would suffer.

Wu Qing led the Zerg puppies to kill into the ghouls, fighting at full strength, constantly killing, and creating a safe space for the two thousand Zerg Hydralisks.

The Zerg Hydralisks leaned against the rock wall and launched a terrible long-range attack under the protection of Wu Qing and the Zerg puppies.

"Eliminate the giant ghouls first!"

Wu Qing ordered the Queen of Zerg.

As soon as the Zerg army formed a formation, the giant ghoul could attack again. Although the corrosive mucus was not very effective against the Zerg, it was very disgusting.

The giant ghoul was huge, and the hydralisk easily completed a round of fire on the target within the attack range.

The overwhelming spike attack hit the conspicuous belly of the giant ghoul, and it burst the belly in one go.

It was like bursting a ball filled with water. With a puff, the black corrosive mucus flowed all over the ground, causing other nearby ghouls to quickly move away and dare not approach again.

The hydralisk suppressed the long-range attack of the ghoul and began to support Wu Qing and the puppy. With the addition of the hydralisk, the pressure on Wu Qing and the puppy guarding the front was immediately reduced a lot.

More and more ghouls rushed over from a distance. If there were no reinforcements, it would not take long for Wu Qing and the Zerg army to be overwhelmed by the increasing number of ghouls.

At this time, the second batch of 5,000 Zergs sent by Wu Qing arrived. Under the cover of the Hydralisks, they rushed out quickly and cooperated with the first batch of Zerg troops to control the huge passage and the area around the passage exit.

Wu Qing and the Zerg experienced the terrible power of the sea of ghouls here. Countless ghouls kept rushing up and attacked the Zerg army fearlessly. One batch fell and another rushed up, as if endless.

The giant ghouls also kept rushing into the range, resisting the attack of the hydralisks, and fired corrosive mucus at the Zerg army. They fell, and the ones behind would continue to rush up.

Later, those ordinary ghouls also learned from the Zerg puppies, surrounded the giant ghouls, and constantly defended the giant ghouls from the attacks of the hydralisks.

Seeing the performance of the ghouls, Wu Qing suddenly realized that this ghoul was simply an alternative copy of the existing combat arms of the Zerg.

Ordinary ghouls correspond to Zerg puppies, and giant ghouls correspond to Zerg hydralisks. They are also good at drilling holes in the ground, have the existence of wise men, have organizational discipline, are fearless of death, and are numerous.

"Is this a coincidence or what?"

Wu Qing did not think much about it. If it was not a coincidence, it would be a bit scary.

However, these ghouls are still not as good as the genuine Zerg. Their individual combat power and mutual cooperation are not as good as the Zerg. Now they are just relying on their numerical advantage to suppress the Zerg army.

When the third batch of 10,000 Zerg troops arrived, the remaining 4,000 Zerg hydralisks all rushed over, and the battle situation in the entire underground space began to reverse.

When 6,000 Zerg hydralisks, led by 50 one-star hydralisks, launched a fierce attack on the rushing ghouls, the ghouls could no longer rush to the front of the Zerg army.

Those giant ghouls were killed by concentrated fire one by one, and it was useless to surround them with more ordinary ghouls for protection. They could not stop the power of the concentrated fire of many hydralisks.

Their bodies will disappear when they die, and it is impossible to rely on their bodies to block the attacks of the Hydralisks.

Since the birth of the Zerg Hydralisks, there has been no loss. The Zerg's battles are almost all centered around them.

In this underground space, they have become the absolute main force again. There is no need for Wu Qing and the puppies to take action again. Large groups of ghouls fall down and disappear in light.

The system's resources are increasing rapidly. Now the number of Zerg puppies is not lacking. The system's gas resources are sufficient, and Wu Qing begins to increase the number of Hydralisks.

As long as the Zerg has enough Hydralisks, whether it is long-range or close combat, air or ground, it will not be a problem.

The Zerg's current tactics of centering on Hydralisks and using puppies as auxiliary is also a last resort. If there are enough Hydralisks, they can push all kinds of enemies all the way, and there is no need to use puppies as cannon fodder.

Now that he has resources, Wu Qing is ready to continuously increase the number of Hydralisks and strive to increase the number of Hydralisks to a level where they can fight alone.

More and more Zerg puppies rushed over, and the number of Zerg troops soon reached 30,000.

The ghouls have been charging continuously, trying to consume the long-range attack capabilities of the hydralisks. Although they have been suffering losses, their number in the entire underground space has not decreased significantly. Obviously, there are other channels that are constantly replenishing troops.

The sustained attack capabilities of the hydralisks are indeed limited, but as long as they are willing to consume resources, their attacks can last for a long time. If you want to compete with the Zerg hydralisks in consumption, you have to pay a high price.

The hydralisks that the Zerg quickly hatched are constantly coming to join the hydralisk army. The total number of Zerg hydralisks reached 7,000 not long after.

Wu Qing looked at the ghouls in the underground space, whose number did not change much, and felt that the efficiency of killing enemies by relying solely on the hydralisk was still a bit low. More than 20,000 Zerg puppies were a waste. He asked the queen to convert it. Zerg puppies and ghouls could still make a lot of resources by fighting head-on.

Such a cost-effective deal, of course, must be done.

Under Wu Qing's order, the Zerg hydralisk released the fire suppression in one direction and released a large number of ghouls.

A large number of puppies pounced on them and fought with the ghouls.

Wu Qing led the Zerg guards and rushed into the group of ghouls. The weapon in his hand was replaced with a long spear. His spear skills were superb. The black long spear was like a dragon going out to sea, turning the river and the sea upside down, and a large number of ghouls were lifted up, and they all turned into light and disappeared.

The Zerg guards around him all held double swords and fought like the Zerg wielding sword arms, killing the ghouls around them efficiently.

Led by Wu Qing and the Zerg guards, the Zerg puppies continued to charge forward, slowly suppressing the large number of ghouls that rushed up.

With the continuous loss of Zerg puppies, the growth rate of system resources accelerated again, and a steady stream of Zerg puppies rushed to join the battle through the huge passages dug by the ghouls.
